# BigBrain3DHistology

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A high-resolution 3D histological reconstruction technique used to quantify cellular architecture across cortical layers and regions. It offers ground-truth structural data for calibrating TCC/iNEST models of cortical organization and validating neuromorphic connectivity patterns.
